widget.name: Guided Tour
widget.description: Guide users through your app with a step-by-step tour.

property.caption: Run trigger
property.description: Boolean attribute. When set to true, the tour starts. Set back to false via a nanoflow to allow re-triggering.

property.caption: On tour finish
property.description: Action to execute after the last step is completed.

property.caption: On tour exit
property.description: Action to execute when the user closes or skips the tour before finishing.

property.caption: Steps data source
property.description: Data source returning the list of tour step objects.

property.caption: Target selector
property.description: CSS selector or bare identifier for the target element. A bare word like "myId" matches both #myId and .myId.

property.caption: Step content
property.description: Widgets to render inside the tooltip for each step.

property.caption: Advance on click
property.description: When enabled, clicking the highlighted element automatically advances to the next step.

property.caption: Progress indicator
property.description: Bind to an enum with values: None, Dots, or Step_Count. Controls the progress indicator style shown in the tooltip.

property.caption: Progress scope
property.description: Bind to an enum: Local (steps on this page only) or Global (steps across all pages, requires Total step count and Step offset).

property.caption: Total step count
property.description: Total number of steps across all pages. Only used when Progress scope is set to Global.

property.caption: Step offset
property.description: Steps completed on previous pages (use 0 for the first page). Only used when Progress scope is set to Global.

property.caption: Custom styles (JSON)
property.description: Optional JSON object to override react-joyride styles (see react-joyride docs → Styling).
